# Low Poly Fantasy Weapon Pack

Creator: Rostislav Gnatovsky (Cardinal Zebra).
Creator page supplied in the pack: https://cardinalzebra.itch.io/
Source: user-supplied local download; original FBX files and Texture.png preserved.

Permission is recorded in the original `Low Poly Fantasy Weapon Pack/credits.txt`:
the creator permits editing and use in commercial and non-commercial projects;
credit is optional. No CC0 license is claimed here.

Phase 25 Hub presentation uses `Low Poly Fantasy Weapon Pack/Greatsword.fbx`
for warrior_tier_1 (Emberfang Greatblade) and `Longbow.fbx` in the same folder
for archer_tier_1 (Stormstring Recurve). M_CardinalWeapons.mat uses the supplied
Texture.png palette with a project-created URP Lit material. Scene transforms
fit the unmodified real meshes to the existing hand attachments.

Longsword.fbx and Shortbow.fbx were inspected but are not assigned as stronger
Tier II upgrades. Warrior Tier II uses the distinct two-handed `Greataxe.fbx`
from the same folder. Archer Tier II remains unassigned: no convincing third
masterwork bow is available in the imported packs. Starter weapons are unchanged.
